about:
Superior Plastics operates as a custom plastic injection molder in Fort Worth, Texas. The company was founded in 1981 and has occupied its current Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex facility since 1985. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named in available sources.

The shop provides mold building and tooling, custom injection molding, drop shipping, and private labeling. Its press lineup ranges from a 42-ton Arburg and an 85-ton electric Cincinnati machine up to a 400-ton Toyo, supplemented by Van Dorn and Milacron presses. The company processes commodity, engineering-grade, and high-temperature thermoplastic resins. Facility size, headcount, annual volumes, and part-number counts are not published.

Superior Plastics serves aerospace, aircraft instrument, construction, electronics, industrial, military, oil field, and telecommunications markets. Named customers include AT&T, Lucent Technologies, Lockheed Martin, and Hill Air Force Base.

The company states it was built on principles of on-time delivery, competitive pricing, commitment to excellence, and outstanding customer service. It also highlights its ITAR registration and AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications as differentiators.
